item.tib: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bcu drug pa'i bskang bshags rin chen sgron me
item.coloph: de ltar bskang bshags don tshangs 'jug bde'i gsang sngags khyad par can las khyad par 'phags pa bskang bshags rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba/ rang gzhung dkyil 'khor stong dang drug brgya nges pas shes rab kyi snang ba thob pa dmu rgyal nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ byang gi gnas rnams klu btsan del po 'du ba'i gnas/ gnam snang gyog po zhes bya ba'i sgar thog tu brtsams pa phyogs dus kun la dge legs su 'phel bar gyur cig//
